India's flagship river-interlinking scheme, the Ken-Betwa Link Project, promises to move surplus water from the Ken to the water-scarce Betwa basin — but critics warn it will submerge large tracts of the Panna Tiger Reserve and uproot thousands of villagers. Earlier this week, a 15-day protest against the project in Madhya Pradesh ended abruptly as police cleared the agitation site. Read more.

Why are we talking about it in a climate puzzle? Because there is no Ecological justice without Social justice.
